entries.name: LM Studio
entries.detectionConvention: User-approved models root; publisher/model/file.gguf and validated GGUF v2/v3 header. No API discovery.
entries.evidenceStatus: compiled storage adapter with synthetic contract tests; provider runtime unverified
entries.fallback: Unknown and issue for unrecognized layout, split GGUF, or Safetensors; incomplete for recognized partial artifacts

entries.name: GPT4All
entries.platformStatus: macOS and Apple Silicon Metal documented
entries.detectionConvention: Explicit approved download root; validated GGUF v2/v3. incomplete- prefix and .incomplete suffix denote partial files. Remote .rmodel configurations are excluded.
entries.evidenceStatus: GPT4All v3.10.0 source convention reviewed; synthetic header, partial, legacy, shared-identity and symlink contract tests pass
entries.fallback: Legacy .bin and split GGUF remain Unknown; no runtime, deletion or remote-config capability

entries.name: Jan

capabilities.storage: read-only model.yml and GGUF inventory; unreleased

entries.detectionConvention: Approved Jan data root; llamacpp/models only. Bounded flat model.yml scalar subset binds same-directory GGUF path and expected size.
entries.evidenceStatus: Official data-folder schema reviewed 2026-09-09; synthetic manifest, malformed header, missing weights, traversal and unsupported YAML tests pass
entries.fallback: Unknown or issue for unsupported manifests and incomplete weights; legacy JSON, advanced YAML and Jan MLX layout unsupported

entries.name: LocalAI
entries.platformStatus: Native macOS ARM64 binaries documented; backend-specific validation required
entries.detectionConvention: User supplies numeric-loopback root endpoint and exact model ID per installation. /readyz and /v1/models establish unauthenticated reachability; one-token /v1/chat/completions separately checks inference.
entries.evidenceStatus: Synthetic adapter and HTTP contracts pass, including stale mapping, auth/status failure and bounded response; live LocalAI backend not verified
entries.fallback: No implicit endpoint, provider identity, file identity, auth secrets, launch, download or Stop; unsupported configurations fail closed

entries.name: Open WebUI
entries.platformStatus: macOS host documented; browser client independent of inference hardware
entries.detectionConvention: User supplies local UI root and model reference. Fresh WTM inference evidence for the installation is required; reviewed browser URL has exactly one encoded model parameter.
entries.evidenceStatus: Synthetic freshness, URL injection, expiration and broker validation tests pass; live authenticated WebUI session not verified
entries.fallback: Browser manages login; UI/backend mapping remains user-supplied. No auto-submitted prompt, storage ownership, server launch or process Stop
